definitions.explanation: A name that identifies a person, including both given names and family names. Used especially in contexts discussing names as a category or system.

examples.japanese: {人名|じんめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The reading of people's names is difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人名|じんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Chinese characters are often used in Japanese personal names.

examples.japanese: {人名|じんめい}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: The kanji permitted for use in personal names are determined by law.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person) + {名|めい} (name). A formal, categorical term used when discussing names as a topic — in everyday conversation, ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ (name) is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人名|じんめい}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ — dictionary of personal names
- {人名|じんめい}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧ — kanji approved for use in names
- {人名|じんめい}{録|ろく} — name register; directory of people
- {人名|じんめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧ — origin of a person's name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ — name (everyday term; can refer to any name, not just people's)
- ⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧ — full name (formal; used on forms and documents)
- ⟦{姓名|せいめい}→姓名：03764_seimei⟧ — family name and given name (formal pair)
- ⟦{人命|じんめい}→人命：04286_jinmei⟧ — human life (same reading but different kanji and meaning)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {人名|じんめい}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧ (name-use kanji) is a legally defined set of characters that can be used in given names. Parents must choose characters from this list or the ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧ when registering a child's name.
